title: List the SIFT of a key that is disabled in metadata on the Indexes part
summary: The Indexes part on the Table Information page now lists disabled SIFTs for keys that are disabled in metadata and define SumIndexFields, allowing administrators to enable them.
key_points: Indexes List Part now lists a disabled SIFT row for keys that are disabled in metadata and define SumIndexFields
Mirrors the existing condition used for regular indexes
Administrators can select and enable such SIFTs, relying on the platform counterpart change
The Key table is unchanged, so AL code reading MaintainSIFTIndex is unaffected
Enabling a row for a key with MaintainSIFTIndex false is still rejected by the platform
